title: Drunk Marine Recruiter Stabs 11 Year Old Girl
description:
Bodycam footage shows Kent County police responding to a disturbing home invasion where Marine recruiter Ricardo Perez Castillo, 25, allegedly broke into a random home and stabbed an 11-year-old girl multiple times while she slept. Watch the investigation unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
